content:
Iris: Heads-up — customer reports a burst of reconnects from a mobile app. Traced it to ws-ping/pong miscounts on edge-usw-04. Clients drop connection after three missed pongs.
Pavel: any recent changes to the ping scheduling? We tweaked jitter last week to align pings across proxies.
Iris: yes—commit runtime/edge/2026-03-26/ping-jitter-adjust. Repro locally by simulating high event churn + CPU starvation on the event loop.
Nora: logs from one affected session:```
[2026-03-26T12:02:11Z] conn=zz12 send: PING seq=101
[2026-03-26T12:02:11Z] conn=zz12 evloop=busy drop_pong_check
[2026-03-26T12:02:12Z] conn=zz12 send: PING seq=102
[2026-03-26T12:02:12Z] conn=zz12 recv: PONG seq=101
[2026-03-26T12:02:13Z] conn=zz12 recv: PONG seq=102
[2026-03-26T12:02:13Z] conn=zz12 decision: missed 1 (window) -> keepalive=false -> client_reconnect
```
Iris: note the edge counted PONGs late and still considered the early check as missed. Off-by-window when event loop is delayed.
Pavel: ah, so our missed-pong counter is based on ping timestamps vs now rather than matching seq ids within a sliding window. When loop delays, pongs arrive but after the check, we increment missed.
ConsoleBot: alert: route=usw.* keepalive_miss_rate > 0.3% (5m)
Nora: Console shows a correlated spike in "reconnects" and also the per-route token usage went up because mobile clients re-sent inflight messages after reconnect. 
Iris: customer impact: brief UX hiccups + small billing blips. Ops: is there dedupe on replays?
Ops: billing dedupe exists for identical message ids within 30s, but mobile SDK replays often generate new message ids so billing can spike. We'll need to notify billing.
Pavel: short-term mitigation options: 1) change keepalive logic to require N consecutive missed seq ids (match ping seq) before counting a disconnect, 2) widen the check window to tolerate event-loop delays, 3) console UX: surface a "keepalive jitter detected" badge so customers know its likely infra jitter.
Nora: prefer 1) but scoped to devices flagged as high-latency (mobile UA) to avoid lengthening detection for all clients.
Iris: I can implement a cheap fix in proxy: map ping_seq -> outstanding set, only decrement if corresponding pong arrives; only increment missed when ping_seq older than window and missing. Minimal patch:```
--- a/edge/keepalive.go
+++ b/edge/keepalive.go
@@ -78,7 +78,11 @@ func checkKeepalive(conn) {
- if now - lastPing > pongTimeout { missed++ }
+ // use seq-aware check to avoid event-loop delay false positives
+ if outstanding.Contains(oldestSeq) && now - pingTs(oldestSeq) > pongTimeout {
+   missed++
+ }
```
Pavel: sounds good. Also add metric edge.ws.keepalive_seq_miss.
DeployBot: rolling canary deploy runtime/edge/2026-03-26/ping-seq-fix -> usw-canary (id: d-9999).
DeployBot: canary deploy complete: 3 instances updated, health OK.
Iris: canary metrics: keepalive_miss_rate down 88% on canary hosts. reconnects/reported customers dropped. Nice.
Nora: Console: let's add an annotation to the per-route chart when edge.ws.keepalive_seq_miss > threshold and a tooltip "probe: sequence-aware keepalive false positives detected; probe fix rolling". Small frontend change.
Ops: FYI billing sees a small delta in token usage; I'll coordinate with billing to watch for regressions.
Pavel: follow-ups: 1) postmortem note + tradeoff doc on seq-aware vs time-window detection, 2) consider exposing an opt-in keepalive_profile=mobile for customers to tune client-side SDK behavior, 3) add regression test that simulates event-loop stalls.
Iris: added repro harness and unit test. Will open PR for canary -> prod after 4h of stable metrics.
Nora: I'll ship the console annotation now (low-risk).
Iris: thanks all — will update thread after 4h.
